lemmas.name: sq48
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n r : Nat), (r * r ≤ n ∧ n < (r + 1) * (r + 1)) → (decide (r * r = n) = true ↔ ∃ i : Nat, i * i = n)
lemmas.proof:
by intro n r hr
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hr
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨r, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases lt_trichotomy i r with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso; nlinarith
    · subst heq; exact hi
    · exfalso; nlinarith

lemmas.name: sq48_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n r : Nat), (r * r ≤ n ∧ n < (r + 1) * (r + 1)) → isPerfectSquare_postcond n (decide (r * r = n))
lemmas.proof:
by intro n r hr
  unfold isPerfectSquare_postcond
  exact sq48 n r hr
